name: cases.vitorx86.dev (personal-portifolio)
description: Cyber-Brutalist engineering portfolio and GitHub documentation hub for vitorx86.dev — structural orthographic grids, 0px geometry, Electric Violet, and Acid Lime telemetry.

body.fontFamily: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

telemetry.fontFamily: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

components.name: TerminalHero
components.description: Architectural blueprint hero split into a 7:5 asymmetric grid with 3D isometric orthographic schematic SVG, live telemetry strip, and brutalist action buttons.

components.name: CategoryHub
components.description: Domain index hub (/systems, /ai, /hardware, /cloud-devtools) with domain-specific CAD SVG schematic, 3-cell module counter strip, and interactive #TAG chip filter bar.

components.name: ProjectGrid
components.description: Structural 1px-collapsed architectural index grid of project cards with /01..0N counters, category/language badges, and directional ↗ CTA bars.

components.name: ProjectHeader
components.description: Unified single-banner architectural specification header with primary <h1>, 4-cell metadata bar, 1-click $ git clone copy bar, and direct GitHub actions.

components.name: EngineerDossier
components.description: Personnel & Architecture Dossier (/about) featuring identity readout, 4-cell live telemetry counters, framed GitHub contribution matrix, and language distribution bars.

components.name: RepoCatalogTable
components.description: Searchable, filterable, and sortable catalog of all public repositories with 4-cell telemetry header and [GRID ⊞] / [TABLE ≡] view mode switcher.

components.name: CyberRightSidebarStats
components.description: Sticky right-hand telemetry panel (260px desktop rail) with live UTC clock and route-aware context links across all 5 surface types.

components.name: TerminalCallout
components.description: Sharp 0px-radius technical callout block with left accent border and monospace header.

components.name: TerminalMermaid
components.description: Client-rendered Mermaid diagram inside an architectural blueprint frame with dark/light theme synchronization and ASCII source fallback.
